mapper.select: WITH requirement_history AS ( SELECT ms.account_id,ap.account_ingredient_product_id, AVG(r.total_required_qty) average_required_qty, COUNT(*) menu_usage_count, MAX(ms.meal_date) last_used_at FROM the_full_order.tb_account_meal_ingredient_requirement r JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_meal_service ms ON ms.meal_service_id=r.meal_service_id JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_ingredient_product ap ON ap.account_id=ms.account_id AND ap.supplier_product_id=r.supplier_product_id WHERE ms.status<>'CANCELED' AND ms.meal_date>=DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE,INTERVAL COALESCE(#{average_days},30) DAY) AND ms.meal_date<=CURRENT_DATE GROUP BY ms.account_id,ap.account_ingredient_product_id ) SELECT b.*,COALESCE(b.current_unit,b.base_unit) current_unit, ROUND(COALESCE(rh.average_required_qty,0)*1.10,3) safe_stock_base_qty, ap.max_stock_base_qty,ap.lead_time_days, COALESCE(b.location_id,ap.default_location_id,'L999') location_id, p.ingredient_id,COALESCE(ai.ingredient_name_std,ai.ingredient_name_raw,im.ingredient_name_std,im.ingredient_name_raw,p.product_name) ingredient_name, COALESCE(NULLIF(ai.category_name,''),im.category_name) category_name, COALESCE(NULLIF(ai.storage_type,''),im.storage_type) storage_type, p.product_name,p.supplier_item_code,p.order_unit, p.base_qty package_base_qty,s.supplier_name,ph.purchase_price, COALESCE(rh.average_required_qty,0) average_usage_qty,rh.last_used_at, COALESCE(rh.menu_usage_count,0) menu_usage_count, ap.max_stock_base_qty total_capacity_qty,ROUND(COALESCE(rh.average_required_qty,0),3) required_qty, ROUND(GREATEST(COALESCE(rh.average_required_qty,0)-b.current_base_qty,0),3) shortage_qty, ROUND(GREATEST(COALESCE(rh.average_required_qty,0)*1.10-b.current_base_qty,0),3) order_needed_qty, (SELECT rd.menu_id FROM the_full_order.tb_account_recipe_detail rd WHERE rd.account_id=b.account_id AND rd.ingredient_id=p.ingredient_id ORDER BY rd.menu_id LIMIT 1) menu_id, (SELECT am.menu_name FROM the_full_order.tb_account_recipe_detail rd JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_menu_master am ON am.account_id=rd.account_id AND am.menu_id=rd.menu_id WHERE rd.account_id=b.account_id AND rd.ingredient_id=p.ingredient_id AND am.del_yn='N' ORDER BY rd.menu_id LIMIT 1) menu_name, CASE WHEN b.current_base_qty<=0 AND COALESCE(rh.average_required_qty,0)>0 THEN 'RED' WHEN b.current_base_qty<COALESCE(rh.average_required_qty,0) THEN 'ORANGE' WHEN rh.last_used_at IS NULL AND ap.max_stock_base_qty>0 AND b.current_base_qty/ap.max_stock_base_qty<=0.30 THEN 'YELLOW' ELSE 'GREEN' END stock_status FROM the_full_order.tb_account_inventory_balance b JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_ingredient_product ap ON ap.account_ingredient_product_id=b.account_ingredient_product_id JOIN the_full_order.tb_supplier_ingredient_product p ON p.supplier_product_id=ap.supplier_product_id JOIN the_full_order.tb_supplier s ON s.supplier_id=p.supplier_id LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_ingredient_master ai ON ai.account_id=b.account_id AND ai.ingredient_id=p.ingredient_id LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_ingredient_master im ON im.ingredient_id=p.ingredient_id LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_supplier_ingredient_price_history ph ON ph.supplier_product_id=p.supplier_product_id AND ph.effective_to IS NULL LEFT JOIN requirement_history rh ON rh.account_id=b.account_id AND rh.account_ingredient_product_id=b.account_ingredient_product_id WHERE b.account_id=#{account_id} AND b.inventory_balance_id=#{inventory_balance_id} ORDER BY FIELD(stock_status,'RED','ORANGE','YELLOW','GREEN'),p.product_name
SELECT * FROM the_full_order.tb_account_inventory_movement WHERE account_id=#{account_id} AND account_ingredient_product_id=#{account_ingredient_product_id} ORDER BY movement_at DESC
